steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Open the Events list as the buyer.
Confirm the Events list and Create Event control rendered without an error.
Verify the Create Event menu offers the Single Stage path.
Provide the required event title before attempting the configuration.

args.goal: On the single-stage create screen, configure the event as an Auction using the Knockout or Dutch strategy, select a reverse/buy auction template, add CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB as the first line item with quantity 10 and Plant Name (LOC-0001), add a second bidding currency, invite two QA_Platform vendors through Participants, keep the 30-minute Start now schedule and save it, then click Publish Event; verify the publish is refused with the message "Currency configuration cannot be added in Knockout / Dutch Auction".

steps.note: Perform and verify the currency configuration restriction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
